_meta.description: Belt-cut PSD measurement at the primary crusher outlet (pivot feed of the model)
_meta.source: client measurement, two tests on the outlet belt conveyor

notes: The curve does NOT reach 100% at 200 mm: ~19% of the stream is coarser than 200 mm.
No data below 19 mm: the fine tail must be extrapolated (hypothesis H-FEED-1).
Test 2 is flat between 120 and 200 mm (77/77): nothing measured in that band on that test.
